about_the_game: You wake up as an automaton in the Cinder temple refurbished into a surplus storage. Explore your surroundings, learn about where you are and figure out what became of your creator, who recently disappeared.
detailed_description: You wake up as an automaton in the Cinder temple refurbished into a surplus storage. Explore your surroundings, learn about where you are and figure out what became of your creator, who recently disappeared.

short_description: The early Demo of House of Wisdom, a first person puzzle game where the protagonist, one of the many creations of a deity, attempts to find out what happened to its creator who recently disappeared, helping the main character’s kins to deal with their distress along the way.
